title: Constructive Distortion: Improving MLLMs with Attention-Guided Image Warping
abstract: arXiv:2510.09741v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often miss small details and spatial relations in cluttered scenes, leading to errors in fine-grained perceptual grounding. We introduce AttWarp, a lightweight method that allocates more resolution to query-relevant content while compressing less informative areas, all while preserving global context. At test time, the approach uses an MLLM's cross-modal attention to perform rectilinear warping of the input image, reallocating spatial resolution toward regions the model deems important, without changing model weights or architecture. This attention-guided warping preserves all original image information but redistributes it non-uniformly, so small objects and subtle relationships become easier for the same model to read while the global layout remains intact. translated_title: 构造性形变：通过注意力引导的图像扭曲改进多模态大语言模型
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在杂乱场景中常常遗漏细小细节和空间关系，导致细粒度感知定位出现错误。我们提出了AttWarp，这是一种轻量级方法，它将更多分辨率分配给与查询相关的内容，同时压缩信息量较低的区域，并保留全局上下文。在测试时，该方法利用MLLM的跨模态注意力对输入图像进行直线性扭曲，将空间分辨率重新分配到模型认为重要的区域，而无需更改模型权重或架构。这种注意力引导的扭曲保留了原始图像的所有信息，但以非均匀的方式重新分布，使小物体和微妙的空间关系对同一模型而言更易于识别，同时保持全局布局完整。在五个基准测试（TextVQA、GQA、DocVQA、POPE、MMMU）和四个MLLM（LLaVA、Qwen-VL、InternVL和InstructBLIP）上，AttWarp均取得了显著提升。
tldr: 提出AttWarp方法，在测试时利用多模态大语言模型的跨模态注意力对输入图像进行非均匀扭曲，将分辨率重新分配到模型关注的区域，从而在不改变模型权重和架构的情况下显著提升细粒度视觉感知能力。
en_tdlr: AttWarp performs attention-guided image warping at test time, reallocating spatial resolution to query-relevant regions to improve fine-grained perception in MLLMs without modifying model weights or architecture.
